description: This file contains an implementation of the PSR-7 UriInterface in PHP, providing methods to parse, construct, and manipulate URIs according to the PSR-7 standard.

classes.name: Uri
classes.description: A PSR-7 URI implementation class that provides methods to parse, construct, and modify URI components according to the PSR-7 standard.

methods.name: fromParts
methods.description: Creates a new Uri instance from an array of URI components.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the URI as a string, composing all components.

methods.name: isDefaultPort
methods.description: Checks if the URI has the default port for its scheme.

methods.name: isAbsolute
methods.description: Determines if the URI is absolute (has a scheme).

methods.name: isNetworkPathReference
methods.description: Checks if the URI is a network-path reference.

methods.name: isAbsolutePathReference
methods.description: Checks if the URI is an absolute-path reference.

methods.name: isRelativePathReference
methods.description: Checks if the URI is a relative-path reference.

methods.name: isSameDocumentReference
methods.description: Determines if the URI is a same-document reference with an optional base URI.

methods.name: removeDotSegments
methods.description: Removes dot segments from a path, deprecated in favor of UriResolver::removeDotSegments.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a relative URI against a base URI, deprecated in favor of UriResolver::resolve.

methods.name: withoutQueryValue
methods.description: Creates a new URI with a specific query parameter removed.

methods.name: withQueryValue
methods.description: Creates a new URI with a specific query parameter added or replaced.

methods.name: withQueryValues
methods.description: Creates a new URI with multiple query parameters added or replaced.
